the_line_we_hook_swing_search.not: FAANG inverses. not one-person toys we have to babysit. not sponsored indexes.
the_line_we_hook_swing_search.search: when a new org appears: is it Rust or open? is it medium? would they want a home that RUNS them together?

what_we_provide_THEM.plain: a house that treats them as organs, not plugins. one VPS running several little guys. science that cites them. AGPL commons. a face (HUD + ORCID + feed) that says they are first class.
what_we_provide_THEM.not: we do not become their vendor. we do not fork them into a costume. we run them, we document the join, we dissolve the paid inverse they replace.

why_they_would_align_to_us: individually they are niche. together on one box they are a civilization. when they notice someone is running them as first class, that is the signal we already named.
